name: openvoxel
description: A teaching voxel world built from first principles with VelarScript.

scripts.generate: node tools/run-validation.mjs --shell "npm run generate --workspace @openvoxel/identities && npm run generate --workspace @openvoxel/blocks && npm run generate --workspace @openvoxel/world-generation && npm run generate --workspace @openvoxel/renderer && npm run generate --workspace @openvoxel/web"
scripts.generate:check: node tools/run-validation.mjs --shell "npm run generate:check --workspace @openvoxel/identities && npm run generate:check --workspace @openvoxel/blocks && npm run generate:check --workspace @openvoxel/world-generation && npm run generate:check --workspace @openvoxel/renderer && npm run generate:check --workspace @openvoxel/web"
scripts.test:gpu: node tools/run-validation.mjs --shell "npm run generate && npm run test:gpu --workspace @openvoxel/game"
scripts.test:web-ui: node tools/run-validation.mjs --shell "npm run generate && node apps/web/tests/ui-acceptance.mjs"
scripts.validate:static: node tools/run-validation.mjs --shell "npm run generate && npm run generate:check && npm run structure:check && npm run test:structure && npm run format:check:workspaces && npm run check:workspaces && npm run test:workspaces && npm run build:workspaces"
scripts.validate:browser: node tools/run-validation.mjs --shell "npm run test:gpu && npm run test:web-ui"
scripts.validate:browser:built: node tools/run-validation.mjs --shell "npm run test:gpu:built && npm run test:web-ui:built"
scripts.validate:quick: node tools/run-validation.mjs --shell "npm run generate && npm run generate:check && npm run structure:check && npm run format:check:workspaces && npm run check:workspaces && npm run test:quick"
scripts.validate:full: node tools/run-validation.mjs --shell "npm run validate:static && npm run validate:browser:built"
